notes.title: Kingdom Crier #30: Introducing Beliefs!
notes.content:
Kingdom Crier #30 time! Wow, time flies!

[h1]Beliefs[/h1]
We've introduced a Beliefs system that allows you to refine your Kingdom's Alignment and Opinions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f09f9988e80a1ab08536af2db0ea22654ebf8936.png[/img]
Double down on what makes your Kingdom unique or make them believe whatever you want, it's your call!

[h2]New Job: Preaching[/h2]
Mortals assigned to Preaching spend their time walking amongst your Nobles and Preaching to ensure adoption of your chosen Beliefs.

The changes are permanent, but take time. You can reverse them by Preaching back in the other direction.

The rate of adoption is controlled by their number of Preaching Skill Points and the 'Preaching Rate' Experience setting.

Other nearby Mortals (including visitors) can be affected by Preaching, but your people (including Serfs and Prisoners) will only be affected by what you've chosen for them.

[h2]Beliefs Tool[/h2]
The new Beliefs Tool allows you to see your Kingdom's Opinions about all Subjects (including Alignment and Kingdom Size) all up in one place.

[i]We've got some work to do...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/640d99da430c723dc37b11c26ad7f6b6a465324b.png[/img]

Use this to make informed decisions about your Kingdom's Beliefs or for an idea of where you should be focusing your efforts!

[h2]Preachings[/h2]
Click and Drag on any of the Bars to define the range of Opinions you Desire for your Kingdom or an individual - these are called Preachings.

[i]Click and drag...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/db8ad7bd76b993eb5e9ea899dd4ffa34808e0f3b.gif[/img]

Time estimates are provided based on the skill of your Preachers, the number assigned to Preaching, and the relevant settings.

Keep in mind that the actual times can vary based on Job Priorities and the number of people that overhear a Preacher.

[h2]Principles[/h2]
Principles are preset groups of Preachings - use these to quickly choose sets of Preachings you'd like your people to adhere to.

[i]What next...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b620cdf28b23da4ed5bd3827c6249b41f27a5258.png[/img]

Ruler Interest shows you how interested your Ruler is in choosing a given Principle.

You can override a Principles Preachings for the Kingdom or individual.

You can revisit them and change them anytime you'd like.

[h2]Autonomous[/h2]
The Beliefs System has an Autonomous Mode if you'd like your Ruler to decide for you.

Keep in mind that their chosen Principles may change whenever you get a new Ruler!

[h2]Preachings Required[/h2]
Not sure whether someone's a good fit? 

[i]Evil... But not a fit.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7e6874ea6872ee4115f24280f0de341e9b763381.png[/img]

We've added a 'Preachings Required' field to the Compatibility Tab of the Mortal Sheet.

Use this to understand how long it'll take for your Preachers to bring them in line with your Kingdom's Beliefs.

[h2]Preach About[/h2]
The Feast Speech has been updated to include a Preach About step.

In addition to speeding up the adoption of your Preachings, this moment can push existing believers deeper into their Beliefs - so it's worth it to Preach About things your people already believe!

[h2]Who are they?[/h2]
We've added a step to the existing Intro that seeds your group with a set of Principles of your choosing.

This refines the options presented during the Choose your Ruler step and seeds their starting Opinions based on the 'Intro: Principle Adoption' Experience Setting.

Let the Gods decide the theme of your playthrough or Choose Your Fate!

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #29: Starting Mortal Customization!
notes.content:
It's time for Kingdom Crier #29!

[h1]Starting Mortal Customization[/h1]
We've expanded the Appearance Editor to include full editing of your Starting Mortals.

[h2]Editing a Mortal[/h2]
[i]Click Edit to Customize a Mortal[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/363388944ff28f950d70ab4c002a1780f51a4daa.png[/img]

[h2]Mortal Editor: General[/h2]
The General Tab lets you edit a Mortal's Race (and Variant), Alignment, Kingdom Size Preference, Sexuality, and their Lexicon.

[i]Evil: Check![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9e880cbe5b00b4ff99ad9c4af8322dba5da7600a.png[/img]
Sexuality Options respect the Settings you chose when starting your game.

[h2]Mortal Editor: Skills[/h2]
On the Skills tab, you edit the Mortal's Skills.

Skills are edited using 3 point pools - one for current Skill, one for Potential, and another for Opinions.

You must take away from something to add to something else.

[i]I've got to do something about this Guarding Skill![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7f75db7ad04ff9066ff235daf6d125b2c784a483.png[/img]
Beyond the Skill Point Pool, Skills are capped at the Mortal's current Level.

[h2]Mortal Editor: Opinions[/h2]
The Opinions Tab gives you the ability to edit their Opinions of all Subjects.

[i]I need to make some changes if we're going to make things out of Orcs![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/00ad60d9dd44074c34b3fe92c125251907d75612.png[/img]
[h2]Bonus Points[/h2]
There are options to grant Bonus Points to each of the Pools when you Customize your Difficulty.

Easy defaults to 5 Bonus Points in each of the pools while all other Difficulties default to none.

[h1]Intro: Mortal Compatibility[/h1]
We've expanded the information available when choosing your Ruler to include detailed Compatibility breakdowns for the two Mortals who will join your Kingdom and for the Mortal who will not (the Outcast).

[i]Use this to make a more informed decision and to drive your editing![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/10241ec98ec84ed6962675a08fa3cccc0301202f.png[/img]
[h1]Mortal Visuals[/h1]
We've added a new Option to tone down the extremes of Mortal Visuals. 

This defaults to 50% - reigning in some of the more crazy Mortal faces a bit.

[i]I like my Orcs crazy... But maybe just like... A little less crazy.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ad21763094be7076bc8584e9083cc9806d14ff7c.gif[/img]

In addition, we've tweaked the Eyes - most notably for the Orcs.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Add Mortal Editor

    Add Visual Range Option to reign in Extremes

Hearths

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #28: Introducing Choose Your Fate...
notes.content:
Welcome to Kingdom Crier #28!

Introducing...

[h1]Choose Your Fate[/h1]
Choose Your Fate is an initiative that will span multiple Updates for Noble Fates, starting with this Content Update and continuing through Feature Update #6.

At its core, we believe Noble Fates should enable as many players as possible to have the Experience they want to have with it - reacting to and challenging them in the ways they'd like along the way.

To better deliver on this promise, we’ll be introducing a Customizable Starting Scenario, expanding Mortal Customization, adding Map Rerolls, exposing more Settings, and revisiting a few systems - starting with Sexuality.

[h2]Experience Presets[/h2]
With this Content Update, we've introduced the Choose Your Fate step when you begin a New Game which allows you to choose from and customize a few different Experience Presets before you begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7d4f19ac3bca9d18b866f3b1e788edc66ee49f82.png[/img]

This includes a Peaceful Preset if you'd like to play in a world where others do not attack unprovoked.

[h2]Intro[/h2]
Feature Update #6 will introduce a Custom Starting Scenario that will allow you to customize your Mortals, loadout, and choose your starting area before you begin play. In the meantime, we've done a quality of life pass on the existing Intro. 

We've made it Skippable - [L Click] + Hold to skip straight to Choose Your Ruler. 

Hovering over the buttons below a potential ruler will show their information - you no longer need to move away from the Reroll button to see their information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a5118a6aca4ff61b47d8f0bb515a1f101579ff01.png[/img]
In addition, the Strong Opinion list will now contain Job Opinions.

[h2]Sexuality[/h2]
We've reworked Sexuality. Gender has been replaced by Sex and Traits. Sex represents a Mortal’s reproductive organs. Traits have been introduced to represent the nuance of the Mortal’s Sexuality. A Mortal may only have 1 Sex, but can have multiple Traits.

[h3]Settings[/h3]
Sexes (Male, Female), Traits (Straight, Gay, Bisexual, Asexual, Non-Binary), Attraction Modifiers (Race, Age, Prestige), and Titles (Masculine, Feminine) are all optional courtesy of a bunch of new Settings.

A Mortal’s Sex and Sexuality (Traits, Attraction, Titles) are determined at time of Creation. The potential exists that Gods and Magic could optionally influence these in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7309a98e7587ec6247d4dbc9f2142d9e436ca064.png[/img]
These Settings enable new Experiences that weren't possible before - including one where Mortals don’t have reproductive organs, everyone is compatible, and only Opinion drives Attraction - for example.

[h3]Defaults[/h3]
We’ve chosen a Simplified set of these Settings to streamline the default Experiences - Male and Female Mortals, attracted to the Opposite Sex, modified by their Opinion of that Mortal - but you can customize this as you see fit before you begin.

[h3]Reproduction[/h3]
Beyond new Experiences, these changes open the door to Reproduction.

When added, a Male and Female Mortal will be able to Procreate when sharing a Bed. Pregnant Female Mortals will give birth to Offspring. The Offspring’s Sex will be determined at Birth, while their Sexuality (Traits, Attraction, Titles) will be established (using the current Settings) when they become an Adult.

Existing Races will follow this model, but future Races may Reproduce differently. It’s possible that Magic and the Gods could optionally intervene as well.

Reproduction will land before 1.0.

[h3]Existing Saves[/h3]
Existing saves will migrate from Gender to Sex and Traits and continue with their previous Experience (including relevant Mods), though you can change the new Settings mid-game.

Keep in mind that mid-game changes only apply to new Mortals that enter your World.

[h3]Mods[/h3]
Existing Race Mods are compatible with this new setup.

Existing Sexuality Mods that enabled Experiences covered by these new Settings will be retired from the Workshop.

[h2]More to come![/h2]
We're excited about this initiative - increasing the replayability and breadth of Experiences available for everyone while streamlining the default Experience.

Please bear with us while we stand it all up!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #27: Dwarven Furniture! Retuned Crafting, Needs!
notes.content:
Hey! Welcome to Kingdom Crier #27!

[h1]Dwarven Furniture[/h1]
The Dwarves have been around long enough to share their cherished Furniture Plans - use these new sets to decorate your Underground Keeps or High End Noble Lodging!

[h2]Stone Furniture[/h2]
[i]Enjoy the new set of Stone Furniture - better than Ramshackle, not quite as good as Wood.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/855b4eb1e3e959e8a95325e394c60321c42faaaa.png[/img]

[h2]Fine Stone Furniture + Dwarven Decorations[/h2]
[i]Keep your Nobles Happy with Top-tier Fine Stone Furniture - including lots of Colorization options.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ee60b749bf4cfc6f69839d76c35256083b069fe5.png[/img]

[h2]Fine Stone Hearth and Chimney[/h2]
[i]Keep them warm using the new Fine Stone Hearth and Chimney![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/fd5266871ec31fb7c1aed1440ecb35f00dda75dd.gif[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
We continue to burn through our Quality of Life Backlog. Here are the latest improvements!

[h2]Crafting (in 0.28.7)[/h2]
We took buffs on higher end gear up to the next level - moving to a ceiling of +5 for top-end gear.

We rebalanced crafting times for mid and high level gear.

[h2]Needs (in 0.28.7)[/h2]
We rebalanced the Esteem effects of Unmet Needs. They now ramp up over time.

In addition, we revisited the lasting effects, and the importance of unmet needs to other Mortals including the Ruler.

[h2]Trading (in 0.28.7)[/h2]
We added Buff filtering to the trading screen.

[h2]Building[/h2]
You can now Randomize Props that can be Randomized while placing them using the [R] Key.

Randomizing a placed Prop will now Randomize and Color slots that support it.

[h2]Opinions[/h2]
We dropped the records of No Opinion and decreased the likelihood that Mortals would talk about not having one.

In addition, we switched from Mortals having explicit opinions about all the Meal types to deriving their Opinions of Meals from the ingredients. 

These should greatly reduce the Noise in the Opinion System.

[h2]Memory Improvements[/h2]
We found and released ~200mb in redundant Memory!

[h2]Saving Improvements[/h2]
The game will no longer crash when you run out of Disk Space or receive a File System Error. It will warn you and give you a chance to correct the issue before trying to save again.

In addition, it will no longer leave you with corrupt partial save files when this happens.

[h2]Performance Improvements (in 0.28.7)[/h2]
We improved background performance when rebuilding pathing and greatly improved performance in a few scenarios related to building.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[code]Noble Fates 0.28.8.2 Released!
Dwarven Furniture Content Update
QOL Update

Crash Fix
    Potential fix for Icon Capture Crash
    
Beds
    Add Stone Beds (BLD 2)

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #25: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Hey hey - welcome to Kingdom Crier #25!

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
We've been hard at work on a batch of Quality of Life Improvements and the first results dropped today!

[h2]Closeable Wall and Roof Vents![/h2]
The Wooden versions of Wall and Roof Vents can now be closed. Let Heat in during the Spring/Summer and Cool in during the Fall/Winter or close them to keep Heat indoors when you don't need to vent Smoke!

[i]Click to Close![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/bf816b3c45ba49279256a2eb907f6f17ee7044db.gif[/img]

[h2]Rabid Animal Moments[/h2]
The Rabid Animal Moments have been improved so that animals that become Rabid during the event are tracked alongside the others.

[h2]Trading[/h2]
You can now click and Drag on the - and + signs on the Trading screen to quickly select multiple Items.

[i]Finally... Thank the Gods![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b7aebb004bb92d255c89c3359e13c8296e0c706d.gif[/img]

[h2]Mining[/h2]
The Mining Command Type field ("Down" or "In") has been replaced by a "Remove Ceiling" checkbox - it's automatically checked in the situations where "Down" was automatically chosen previously. In addition, a "Remove Ceil(ing) Below" checkbox shows up when appropriate - making it much easier to dig upwards.

[h2]Belongings[/h2]
We disabled reordering of the Portraits while on the Belongings Screen. A great many players, us included, do this in batches, checking their Nobles from left to right - so this makes it much easier to keep track of who you've managed.

If you prefer the old behavior, you can switch back under Options -> Interface.

[h2]Job Time Limits[/h2]
The availability of Time Limits have been separated from Autonomous Job Assignments. Use this to limit how much time your people spend Guarding, for example

[h2]Animals[/h2]
The Animal List will now always list your Animals that are on the current map, regardless of whether they're onscreen or not.

[h1]Sale[/h1]
To celebrate the arrival of the Dwarves, Noble Fates is on sale for 33% off through 7/27! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769420/Noble_Fates/

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Noble Fates 0.28.2.1 Released![/b]
[i]Minor Version[/i]
[code]Wooden Wall and Roof Vents
    Can now be Closed

    Trigger a Rabid Animal Moment if an Animal becomes Rabid without one

    Click and Drag on -/+ to update multiple entries
    Disable -/+ when appropriate
    
Decay SFX
    Only play once every 30s
    Skip if an item of this type has decayed recently
    
Mining
    Replace Type dropdown with "Remove Ceiling" option
    Add "Remove Ceiling Below" option when appropriate
    
Frostcaps
    Lower Yield by 1/2 (still 3x original values)
    Decrease impact of Freezing on Frostcap decay
    Increase impact of Raindrops on Frostcap decay
    
Belongings
    Disable re-ordering of Portraits on Belongings Screen (Re-enable under Interface Options)
    
Job Time Limits
    Enable setting of Job Time Limits while on Autonomous
    Enable setting of Job Time Limits for unassigned Jobs
    
Embark
    Click and Drag on 0/-/+/All to update multiple entries
    Disable 0/-/+/All when appropriate
   
Standing Torch
    Added Standing Torch
    Unlocks at Building 1
    
Defend Rabid Animal Adventure
    Fix Completion detection

    Update visuals!
    
Meals
    Fix color of Meal Icons

    Hide Autonomous Settings

    Fix for bug that caused Work to be interrupted by Jumping up or down

    Improve behavior of Buttons and Checkboxes in lists

Snow
    Now melts near Outdoor Fires
    
Roof Vents
    Can now be Placed over the top of an existing Roof Vent
    
Adding Farms
    Fix Toolbar bug when you Add new Farms via an existing one

Animal List
    Always show Player's Animals

Guided Experience

Grammar
    Resolve multiple spelling issues[/code]
[i]In addition, last week saw the arrival of 0.28.1 - resolving issues and improving Performance[/i]

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #24: Welcome to the Dwarven Domain!
notes.content:
[h1]Dwarven Domain[/h1]
The Dwarves have Emerged - bringing new Technologies, Threats, and an expanded fight for Survival with them!

[previewyoutube=828qJEbonPo;full][/previewyoutube]
Dwarven Domain is Noble Fates Feature Update #5.

Enjoy a more challenging experience than ever before as you brave new extremes, face new monsters, and contend with more interesting Neighbors.

[h1]Meet the Dwarves![/h1]
Although smaller in stature, these Mortals are gifted Miners and Crafters.

[i]You get a beard.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7e5dab75cee2fe9c0db639876adfd9738427aee2.png[/img]
[i]You get a beard.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9fd9e242182224c6daddc3e4edefd85654486098.png[/img]
[i]You get a [strike][b]beard[/b][/strike] [u]tusky moustache thing[/u].[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7edf718849877f085a43d03cf539b82c1aa76c81.png[/img]
Dwarves are a facial hair'd folk (yes, even the ladies) that live longer than Humans but [b]shorter[/b] [i]*sigh*[/i] than Elves.

They like it a bit cooler - just like it is back home. They don't love the Elves and aren't really keen on Farming.

Oh and they need a drink every few days or they get grumpy.

[i]See... Grumpy.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4f2be41a35dea7fdcedd5465bc21b7156809fd33.png[/img]
[h1]Caverns![/h1]
The Dwarves have revealed the existence of (occasionally vast) underground Caverns.

[i]Find and explore Caverns[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/16e537cf2ea1f0e08af4b0f5a1dbf9a90d6710ee.png[/img]
Room Size limits are a thing of the past and standalone structures within a Cavern form separate ownable Buildings.

[h2]Underground Flora![/h2]
These Caverns are home to a Magical underground fungus known as [b]Frostcaps[/b].

[i]Magic Mushrooms![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ac7269b1d975800d07ee71026c72f95fe5da514d.png[/img]
Harness their power to keep your people cool...

But don't overharvest them or their delicate ecosystem will collapse.

[h2]And Fauna![/h2]
An ancient civilization or two spent a little too much time munching on Frostcaps in the dark and have transformed into otherworldly beasts called the [b]Kin[/b].

Disturb their mounds and face their wrath.

[i]Free them from their eternal journey...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e47c0cd0b70ecbbf72aa8c55946337b4b1f647a3.png[/img]
But don't try to eat the Frostcaps...

Seriously, don't.

You can't.

(Yet?)

[h1]Terraforming[/h1]
Dwarves have shared the ability to shape the terrain.

Can't find that perfect hill for your castle?

Stand one up!

[h1]Temperature[/h1]
Temperature now plays an important role in both Happiness and Survival. 

Leverage a stable underground temperature to get out of the extremes of new weather events.

Food Decays faster than ever before - so keep production a priority and keep it cold to extend its life.

[h2]Vents[/h2]
Vents allow the transfer of Warmth and Smoke between spaces.

Use them to let those Firepits breathe indoors or to share the benefit of a Hearth between a few rooms.

[h2]Coolers![/h2]
Throw those Frostcaps in this fancy Pot we made to keep your Nobles cool during a scorching Summer or to build a freezer.

[i]Works like Magic![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/abbe795d219c1ac6dee81ff647434b163b9d1dca.png[/img]
[h2]Exhaust Pipes![/h2]
The Dwarves use Bronze Exhaust Pipes to route Smoke out of the underground...

You can use them to simplify heat management in complex above-ground structures.

[i]Or to make cool looking stuff![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b3484f3c336579329d3f925dc94d2d06e8150357.png[/img]
[h1]New Drinks[/h1]
The Dwarves have shared a few new recipes you can brew to keep your mortals happy.

[i]It turns out that the Dwarves know how to make Moonshine out of almost anything...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/17ae02f56deb1ce936a3c971f8538c8ad6128db6.png[/img]
[h1]The Mycologist[/h1]
There were a few Drunken Hermits stumbling around in the darkness below.

They followed their brethren to the surface so they can drink and talk about Frostcaps.

Bribe them with a drink or eight and they'll let you know where you can find a cavern...

Or [strike][b]take[/b][/strike] [u]trade for[/u] their Frostcaps. Your call.

[h1]Skill Leveling Redux[/h1]
Skill Leveling has been reworked.  Randomization no longer plays a role in Mortal Skill gain.

A Mortal's Potential in a given skill now controls the amount of progress that they make in that skill when earning experience doing something else.

This should lead to more predictable growth patterns (centered on the things they're actually doing) that still yield semi well-rounded Mortals.

Hover over a Skill to see a Mortals progress towards their next point in a given skill.

[h1]Less Hands-on Chitchat[/h1]
A bug prevented Mortals from remembering why they were or were not compatible with their ruler. 

We fixed the bug and made it more likely that Nobles will recall and share their ruler's beliefs - further reducing the amount of hands-on talking you need to do. 

There's still a benefit - especially in speeding up recruiting - but it's required less than ever before.

[h1]Relaxation[/h1]
Comfort has been replaced by Relaxation.

Esteem no longer factors in, Temperature has its own need now, and the effects of Working have been reduced.

In addition, we've added info to the tooltip that shows everything that has affected a Mortal's Relaxation over the last 24h.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
A great many other fixes of all shapes and sizes have made it into this release.

Expect a more challenging early game, a more fruitful mid to late-game, and more interesting Kingdoms around you.

[h1]Sale?[/h1]
To celebrate the launch, Noble Fates is on sale for 33% off - the lowest price to date - as part of the Steam Summer Sale!

We're on Sale through 7/27 - so it's a perfect time to jump in! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769420/Noble_Fates/

notes.title: Kingdom Crier: #23 Announcing Dwarven Domain!
notes.content:
Welcome... Feature Update #5 is called Dwarven Domain!

Dwarves have breached the surface of Noberia - bringing new technologies, threats, and an expanded fight for survival with them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1b11c78fa8753985ff358e069617bdb5b148ab03.png[/img]
[h1]Meet the Dwarves![/h1]
Although smaller in stature, these Mortals are gifted Miners and Crafters.

[i]You get a beard.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/54e47115073747c4c65e1061ac70033142b86600.png[/img]
[i]You get a beard.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4f2be41a35dea7fdcedd5465bc21b7156809fd33.png[/img]
[i]You get a [strike]beard[/strike] sideburns.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/d12b467918594ec46cec85d4c30e3b5a99eaf7d4.png[/img]
Dwarves are a facial hair'd folk (yes, even the ladies) that live longer than Humans but [b]shorter[/b] [i]*sigh*[/i] than Elves.

They like it a bit cooler - just like it is back home. They don't love the Elves and aren't really keen on Farming.

[h1]Caverns![/h1]
The emergence of the Dwarves has lead to the discovery of (occasionally vast) underground Caverns.

[i]Find and explore Caverns[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/16e537cf2ea1f0e08af4b0f5a1dbf9a90d6710ee.png[/img]
Room Size Limits are a thing of the past and standalone structures within a Cavern form separate ownable Buildings.

[h2]Underground Flora![/h2]
These Caverns are home to a Magical underground fungus known as [b]Frostcaps[/b].

[i]Magic Mushrooms![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/f00d3bb7ce043419dc3fd68f1fc96abcf3b0f4fe.png[/img]
Harness their power to keep your people cool.

But don't harvest too many or their delicate ecosystem will collapse.

[h2]And Fauna![/h2]
A few prior Kingdoms spent a little too much time experimenting with Frostcaps in the dark and have transformed into otherworldly beasts called the [b]Kin[/b].

Disturb their mounds and face their wrath.

[i]Free them from their eternal journey...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/370d405a53c827b8b004a82711fdfbb10ae8be56.png[/img]
But don't try to eat the Frostcaps...

Seriously, don't. You can't. (Yet?)

[h1]Terraforming[/h1]
Dwarves have shared the ability to shape the terrain.

[h1]Temperature[/h1]
Temperature now plays an expanded role in Esteem and Survival. 

Leverage a stable underground temperature to get out of the extremes of new weather events.

Food Decays faster than ever before - so keep production a priority and keep it cold to extend its life.

[h2]Vents[/h2]
Vents allow the transfer of Warmth and Smoke between spaces.

Use them to let those Firepits breathe indoors or to share the benefit of a Hearth between a few rooms.

[h2]Coolers![/h2]
Throw those Frostcaps in this fancy Pot we made to keep your Nobles cool during a harsh Summer or to create a freezer.

[i]Works like Magic![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/abbe795d219c1ac6dee81ff647434b163b9d1dca.png[/img]
[h2]Exhaust Pipes![/h2]
The Dwarves use Bronze Exhaust Pipes to route Smoke out of the underground...

You can use them to simplify heat management in complex above-ground structures.

[i]And to make cool looking stuff![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b3484f3c336579329d3f925dc94d2d06e8150357.png[/img]
[h1]Skill Leveling Redux[/h1]
Skill Leveling has been reworked.

Potential now controls the amount of cross-over progress that a Mortal makes in other Skills when earning experience instead a random chance they gain a point in that Skill on Level Up.

This should lead to more predictable growth patterns (centered on the things they're actually doing) that still yield semi well-rounded Mortals.

Hover over a Skill to see a Mortals progress towards their next point in a given skill.

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
The update will launch on 6/26 at 10a PST.
    
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
There are a many other changes included in this update including some that will come online during the Experimental Beta. We'll release full patch notes when the update is released.

[h2]Saves[/h2]
These changes necessitated changes to the save game format, so this update will retire 0.27 saves.

We'll spin up a retired_0_27 set of Steam Betas so that you can continue your 0.27 saves there or go back and visit them whenever you want.
    
[h2]Mods[/h2]
It's quite likely that the update will cause compatibility issues with some mods. We'll use the Experimental Beta to iron out the kinks.

[h2]Experimental Beta[/h2]
We're dusting off the Experimental Beta branch this afternoon to put the update through its paces before releasing it more broadly. Saves from the Experimental Beta will carry over when the full update releases.

You can participate by switching to the Experimental Beta on Steam. Expect issues - but know that we appreciate you helping pave the way for a smooth launch!

[h1]Community Corner[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2976396513][i]13erserk  released the Dragon Set...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/579d38bcf52c979a0c516d2e98ff0896a4a0f66d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to participate in Development!
[url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a54c50c85ab2d954f641161dab4a43e3e8c37ad2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
If you like the game, please consider leaving a Review for the game if you haven't already. These help players that may be on the fence to decide whether or not to support us.


Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!
The Noble Fates Team

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #22: Feature Preview - Temperature!
notes.content:
Oh hey, hope things are well. Here's a new Kingdom Crier.

[h1]Temperature![/h1]
Temperature now plays an important role in your Kingdom's fight for survival.

Item decay has been retuned - sturdy materials last longer while food is affected by the elements more than ever.

[i]Frozen food lasts... how long!?!?![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/375645a69d03ffd416b3e7283b30538a2fdab2a0.png[/img]
Rooms now track and display their internal Temperature - driven by their exposure to the elements (or lack thereof) and the props within.

[i]Cool cellar...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6a12cab21488a04a2ef728394a25df636a225809.png[/img]
Build underground spaces that maintain a consistent, mild Temperature or leverage Vents that transfer Warmth between spaces and allow smoke to escape. 

[i]Indoor Fire Pits![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/70120f9deb2c07e9a6e2d8a768afee6e5a3a3987.png[/img]
The Comfort Mortal Need has been split into Temperature and Relaxation. Moderate Temperature affects Esteem while extremes can lead to permanent Injury or even Death!

[i]Ouch![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a0f72526919bc194f8e7a16e457b31f718b6aabc.png[/img]
Don't worry though, the coming discoveries courtesy of a certain... new... group of Mortals... will help you keep your Nobles alive and happy!

I wonder who it could be???

[h1]Feature Update #5 Status[/h1]
Feature Update #5 is in the home stretch. We're wrapping up the last major feature now, on to some testing and tuning before it's time to announce!

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #21: Feature Preview - Terraforming!
notes.content:
Kingdom Crier #21 ahoy!

[h1]Feature Previews[/h1]
As you've likely noticed, we're taking extra time on our Feature Updates now. The stability of the game has allowed us to strive for a better work/life balance for the team and ensure that each major update from here on out represents a clear step towards 1.0. While they're taking longer, we think that each one will be that much more interesting. The Adventure Update is the first example of this new workflow.

Given that we're spending extra time on these, we thought it was a good time to revisit our approach to announcing new features. Instead of waiting for the Beta of the Feature Update to announce it all in one go, we thought it'd be cool to start sharing Previews of features that we know will be in the update once as we begin to near it's full announcement.

To that end, the first major feature of Feature Update #5 is...

[h1]Terraforming![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c068ff45f1d84129e0f05b2c322dd187744099ed.png[/img]

[i]Build a house in a hole![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/efdadf24bea793b2d4673c069fbc7f6f7672a17e.png[/img]

[i]A land bridge![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/83765d7d34bdbfb2c0310aac5adc14e3741905dc.png[/img]

[i]A root cellar![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/aa8ac91d638e0ed51088bb5c7a70d0b7c47f8f8a.png[/img]

[i]Whatever these weird things are...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/8f6fbe371ed5a8841a4b0f85f049e9567161e956.png[/img]

Or repair the hole that pesky Catapult knocked into the roof of your underground base.

Terraforming follows similar rules to building, with the exception that a terraformed block must be placed on top of or attached to existing Terrain. You can place any of the tile types that map generation uses.

To start, you'll only be able to build things out of Dirt. To keep with the [i]grounded[/i] nature of Noble Fates, this will have a cost in the form of a new resource - Dirt. Dirt will can be gathered by mining, trading, or looting.

[h1]Feature Update #5 Status[/h1]
Feature Update #5 is quite far along now. There are only one or two features left to build then we'll enter the bug fixing and tuning phase at which point we'll announce.

Terraforming is just one of the features of Feature Update #5 - any guesses as to what else may come with it?

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #20: Door Locks and Roadmap Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to Kingdom Crier #20 Kontras.

Until now, Barricades have represented the state of the art in Kingdom Security.

The Builders have spent some time standing around with gears above their heads and discovered...

[b]Door Locks![/b]
[i]Use these to keep your spaces secure[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/fdba5254528505b049af6542d59687503aff1aff.png[/img]

Door Locks control access to your important spaces and keep Bandits away from your goods. These Unlock at Building Level 5 and cost 24 Copper to add to a Door. Adding a Lock doubles the Health of a door.

[i]Leverage the new permissions UI to control access[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ac8cd4c4714515fca60978a6ccb77c18006ab669.png[/img]

Doors with Locks close more quickly than those without - but beware of tailgaters! Permissions prevent someone from opening a Locked Door, but anyone can walk through a door that's already open!

[i]Beware of tailgaters![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/8df3c5702bd9021d0aa6975d53a0d785b58e25e7.png[/img]

The existing Lock system has been renamed to Barricades, retaining the previously functionality. The discovery of Locks has lowered the difficulty of Barricades to Building Level 2 and the cost to 12 Wood. Barricading a Door doubles its health - giving you a little extra time to get into position and dispatch attackers.

[i]The trusty Barricade[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/0c86011d1b3dacb6c970a10d704ee813170672d2.png[/img]

[i]Finally, you can Barricade a Locked Door to stack the Health boosts for added protection![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ad30709675a41c1104254fb56ddcbd524c158abd.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Noble Fates 0.27.6.2 Released!
Content Update #16
[code]Crash Fixes
    Fix for multiple crashes related to Combat
    Fix for crash related to Items Decaying
    
Add Door Locks
    Door Locks add the ability to control access to spaces
    Unlock at Building 5
    Ingredients: 24 Copper
    Other Factions can grant the Player access to their locks
    
Door Barricades
    Existing Door Locks are now known as Door Barricades
    Move to Tactical Research Category
    Unlock at Building 2
    Ingredients: 12 Wood
    Update Visuals
    
Reports (thanks!)
    Improve Unreachable Detection
    Fix broken pathing when Stairs are built above a Terrain Ramp
    Improve reporting when Cooking is Disabled for all Available Ingredients
    Fix for multiple instances of dispatched parties not returning
    Fix for bug that allowed an attempt to path to unreachable space
    Fix for Pathing issue related to Stairs
    Fix for Pathing issue related to Uncrated Props
    
Crafting
    Show Locked Recipes by default
    
Desertion
    Prevent Raiders from Deserting their Kingdom during Retreat
    
Ordering
    Don't Select Hidden Blueprints when Right-Click Ordering
    
Grass
    Increase rate of Terrain Grass regrowth[/code]
[h1]Roadmap Update![/h1]
It's been a bit - so let's update the Roadmap!

As a reminder - there are 3 types of updates for Noble Fates - Updates that address bugs and issues (including those that are listed on the Backlog and those that you Report in-game); Content Updates that focus on expanding existing systems and filling them with additional content; and Feature Updates that add new features to the game expanding the overall breadth of what the game has to offer.

[h2]Priority Fixes[/h2]
[i]Progress against the Priority Fixes that we outlined on 8/9[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/48978646099eabb0d4b1eed45f616d8742b11dd6.png[/img]

[i]Details[/i]
[code]Crashes
    Fixed 65+ additional crashes, bringing the total to 165+!

Adventures
    Go on Adventures to Help your neighbors out
    Delegate to followers and stay home if you prefer

Fine Stone Building Tier
    Made from Stone Blocks
    Adds Arches, Spires, and Portcullis
    
Tactical Props
    Buildable Catapults
    Useful Chevals

Shields
    Great against Projectiles
    Block Animal and Monster Attacks

Crime 
    Added Crime Tracking
    Factor Crime into Esteem Changes

Kingdoms Map
    Reworked and Improved

Demands and Gifts
    From other Rulers based on their Opinions of you

Tames
    Added Pastures to keep Tames contained
    Added ability to eat from Stockpiles

Wolves
    Added Wolves
    Added Hunted Notification

Dangerous Animal Event
    Added Dangerous Animal Event

Monsters
    Improved Imp Behavior
    Improved Breacher Behavior
    Spawning Improvements
    
Rabid Animals
    Improved Flow and Difficulty

Character Visuals
    Less Crazy Combinations
    Added Character Appearance Editor

Conversation Refinement
    Surface inconsequential opinions Less
    Less need to talk to your people        
    
Camera
    Improved Fine Camera Panning
    Added Camera Panning Settings
    
Reporting
    Added in-game Reporting tool

Mods
    Added Versioning[/code]
That's a lot of changes! It's worth noting how much of our effort we've been able to put towards improvements and content instead of fixes! We have a pretty stable game now.

[i]Current Priorities[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c4ffdcdc6730808d7655fc936ef5b1050217657c.png[/img]

Localization has climbed the list and is under way now. It's a complicated task for a game with so much procedural text, but we're hard at work on it. It will likely land between Feature Update #5 and Feature Update #6.

Beyond that, there are a number of systems and interfaces that could use their second pass to streamline and improve the player's experience, so those are starting to become important to us.

[h2]Content Updates[/h2]
[i]We've released 16 Content Updates so far![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c159412b6a05b75a8b064672893f6662d030c312.png[/img]

There have been 3 Content Updates since the last Roadmap Update!
[code]Content Update #14: Wolves
Content Update #15: Mortal Customization
Content Update #16: Door Locks[/code]
We'll continue to work on these and release them as they're ready,

[h2]Feature Updates[/h2]
Finally, we have the Feature Updates. As a reminder, 8 of these will arrive during Early Access. 4 have landed so far.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769420/view/3649634951898494840]

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #18: The Adventure Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to Kingdom Crier #18 - you are now free to play...

[b]The Adventure Update![/b]

[previewyoutube=Z5pwwnvsdfk;full][/previewyoutube]
This update marks the halfway point of Early Access for Noble Fates - so we took the time to give it some extra love and attention!

[h1]Adventures![/h1]
The other Rulers in your world leverage their new Magical Messenger Hawks to ask you to undertake Adventures for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/480110a8f97d3b3ed3547c728e297d0c80ee1266.jpg[/img]

These Adventures take you to distant lands in the world of Noberia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4d3d8f665db5affa7de59e371f0cede9c4d78b52.jpg[/img]
    
Embark on the journey yourself or dispatch a Party to handle them for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e61666abfa563370ccfef097797b96411fcbe97f.jpg[/img]
    
Adventures affect your Relationships, yield Loot, and even Start and End Wars!
    
[h1]Build an Epic Castle out of Stone Blocks![/h1]
Builders have invented Stone Cutting Tables that Crafters can work at to produce Stone Blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/27f7381e880609f961a43b63c70077c7430545a2.jpg[/img]
    
Leverage these Blocks to build Epic Castles with a complete new tier of structures including Floors, Walls, Doors, Roofs, and Stairs.
    
Use the new Add-ons to add decorative Spires, Supports, Arches, and even a Portcullis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/3e70f4e3c9c34df53510a82135cd6c5e1f777d75.png[/img]
    
The improvements to Stone workmanship made it so the existing Stone props are now cheaper to produce - providing a smoother transition into the mid-game.

[h1]The Shield has been Discovered![/h1]
Mortals have learned to fashion Shields out of Wood, Hide, Leather, Copper, and Iron!
    
Shields are a new Secondary piece of Gear that are great at countering incoming Ranged Attacks...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9fcf4b2c896236f858573a6d0fbb7c36bba86db9.jpg[/img]
    
Introduce the ability to block against Melee attacks from Animals and Monsters...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2937e04c7f03bb45504a953e09d24c3792f56f4e.jpg[/img]
    
And even work alright against Mortals in the hands of a skilled defender!

[h1]Tactical Improvements[/h1]
Your Mortals have learned to harness the power of the Catapult - use them on Adventures or to add that finishing touch to your Castle's defenses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/64e2b937b1908d638c62c0a18e110babe8652436.jpg[/img]
    
The Cheval has been improved to grant a 50% move speed reduction for any character that comes into contact with one.

Finally, you can leverage the power of the Grappling Hook when controlling your ruler to get to those hard to reach places!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/41db151d937af262d0688dacd1592f04bf6e72ac.jpg[/img]

[h1]Surprise: Crime![/h1]
We now track and surface the Crime that a Mortal has committed. Raiders, Bandits, Kidnappers, Rebels, and other Criminals can now be held accountable even if they try to flee!

Punishment (Killing, Imprisonment, Indentured Servitude) of Criminals is judged less harshly by Good and Neutral Mortals.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
A great many other fixes of all shapes and sizes have made it into this release.

Expect a better ramp through the mid-game, better trading options, better room detection, improved user experience, and more balance out of the Kingdoms around you.
    
[h1]Sale[/h1]
To celebrate the launch, Noble Fates is on sale for 30% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769420/Noble_Fates/\

notes.title: Kingdom Crier #17: Announcing The Adventure Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to Kingdom Crier #17 - it's time to announce...

[b]The Adventure Update![/b]

We've been hard at work on the next feature update and are finally ready to share it with you! 

This update will mark the halfway point of Early Access for Noble Fates - so we took the time to give it some extra love and attention!

[h1]Introducing - Adventures![/h1]
The Rulers in your world leverage their new Magical Messenger Hawks to send Petitions asking you to undertake Adventures to help them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/480110a8f97d3b3ed3547c728e297d0c80ee1266.jpg[/img]

These Adventures take you to distant lands in the world of Noberia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4d3d8f665db5affa7de59e371f0cede9c4d78b52.jpg[/img]
    
Embark on the journey yourself or dispatch a Party to handle them for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e61666abfa563370ccfef097797b96411fcbe97f.jpg[/img]
    
Your performance will affect the petitioner's opinion of your Ruler, yield Loot, and can even start or end a War!
    
[h1]Build an Epic Castle out of Stone Blocks![/h1]
Builders have invented Stone Cutting Tables that Crafters can work at to produce Stone Blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/27f7381e880609f961a43b63c70077c7430545a2.jpg[/img]
    
Leverage these Blocks to build Epic Castles with a complete new tier of structures including Floors, Walls, Doors, Roofs, and Stairs.
    
Use the new Add-ons to add decorative Spires, Supports, Arches, and even a Portcullis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/31ec2ff1a5a7c58f1ee34d2b26edae15bbbdf8c3.jpg[/img]
    
The improvements to Stone workmanship made it so the existing Stone props are now cheaper to produce - providing a smoother transition into the mid-game.

[h1]The Shield has been Discovered![/h1]
Mortals have learned to fashion Shields out of Wood, Hide, Leather, Copper, and Iron!
    
Shields are a new Secondary piece of Gear that are great at countering incoming Ranged Attacks...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9fcf4b2c896236f858573a6d0fbb7c36bba86db9.jpg[/img]
    
And introduce the ability to block against Melee attacks from Animals and Monsters...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2937e04c7f03bb45504a953e09d24c3792f56f4e.jpg[/img]
    
But put the wielder at a disadvantage against the Melee attacks of other Mortals.

[h1]Tactical Improvements[/h1]
Your Mortals have learned to harness the power of the Catapult - use them on Adventures or to add that finishing touch to your Castle's defenses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/64e2b937b1908d638c62c0a18e110babe8652436.jpg[/img]
    
The Cheval has been improved to grant a 50% move speed reduction for any character that comes into contact with one.

Finally, you can leverage the power of the Grappling Hook when controlling your ruler to get to those hard to reach places!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/41db151d937af262d0688dacd1592f04bf6e72ac.jpg[/img]
    
[h1]Release Date[/h1]
The update will launch on 12/13 at 10a PST.
    
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
There are a many other changes included in this update including some that will come online during the Experimental Beta. We'll release full patch notes when the update is released.

[h2]Saves[/h2]
These changes necessitated changes to the save game format, so this update will retire 0.26 saves.

We'll spin up a retired_0_26 set of Steam Betas so that you can continue your 0.26 saves there or go back and visit them whenever you want.
    
[h2]Mods[/h2]
It's quite likely that the deep changes necessary to support multiple maps will cause compatibility issues with some mods. We'll use the Experimental Beta to iron out the kinks.

[h2]Experimental Beta[/h2]
We're dusting off the Experimental Beta branch to put the update through its paces before releasing it more broadly. Saves from the new Experimental Beta will carry over when the full update releases.

You can participate by switching to the Experimental Beta on Steam. Expect issues - but know that we appreciate you helping pave the way for a smooth launch!

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to participate in Development!
[url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a54c50c85ab2d954f641161dab4a43e3e8c37ad2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
If you like the game, please consider leaving a Review for the game if you haven't already. These help players that may be on the fence to decide whether or not to support us.


Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!
The Noble Fates Team

notes.title: Kingdom-Crier #16: Wolves and Ranching!
notes.content:
Hey Kontras, welcome to Kingdom-Crier #16!

[h1]Content Update #14: Wolves[/h1]
Wolves are searching the lands of Noberia for food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ae1790e8400352572949aac88682c42be6d2ce7f.png[/img]

[i]Pack Hunters, they'll call groups into action to attack their target.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/9e588114942602d184ab169eff41600c931f2d2f.png[/img]

[i]Be careful, or you may find an outnumbered Mortal in their sights.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6c1383f04869accb5100c4cf05e083827316490d.png[/img]

[i]Taming them can be tricky, but we're sure you'll figure it out![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/164025f118677be1535da7a116961a846a1aeba4.gif[/img]

[i]When tamed, they can act as a great scout or first line of defense, but make sure you keep them fed.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7a114f62642d36cd2aa574f1f5f5e624ef9bd258.png[/img]

[h2]Ranching Updates[/h2]
In addition, we added support for specifying the Animal Types allowed per pasture and improved behavior around Raiders attacking tames.

[i]Tames will now eat from stockpiles that contain the appropriate food in their pasture.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1263735a4ce381376de488e2b807a1a7674830c6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
Noble Fates 0.26.1.39 Released!
Content Update #14 - Wolves!
[code]Wolves
    Seek and consume Corpses, Raw, and Cooked Meat
    Hunt Animals for Food (Wild only when Tamed)
    Hunt Humanoids that are outnumbered (when Untamed)
    Pack Hunters - Howl to call others into the Hunt
    Stats
        Move Speed - 1.65
        Health - 30
        Melee - 4
        Attack Rate - 2
        Value - 50
    
Add Dangerous Animals Moment

Tamed Herbivores (Cows, Boars, Deer)

Cows

Mods
    Food can now specify whether Food is edible by Humanoids, Herbivore Animals, or Carnivore Animals (or all three!)
    By default, previous food is edible by Humans
    By default, previous animal feed is edible by Herbivores[/code]
[h1]Feature Update #4[/h1]
Work on Feature Update #4 continues in earnest!

notes.title: Kingdom-Crier #15: Roadmap Update!
notes.content:
Hey Kontras - it's time for Kingdom-Crier #15!

[h1]Roadmap Update[/h1]
It's been a bit since we've updated the Roadmap, so let's take a look.

As a reminder, there are 3 types of updates for Noble Fates - Updates that address bugs and issues including those that are listed on the Priority Fixes list; Content Updates focus on expanding existing systems and filling them with content; and Feature Updates that add new features to the game expanding the overall breadth of what the game has to offer.

[h2]Priority Fixes[/h2]
[i]Progress against the Priority Fixes that we outlined on 3/8.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/2d6f8bc4df3b052c49eefd2f1622e9a1cee72e0e.png[/img]

Details:
[code]Crashes
    Fixed 50+ additional crashes, bringing the total to 100+!

Performance
    Improved Performance of Large Bases
    Improved Rendering Performance
    Improved Loading Performance

Memory
    Improved Memory Usage
    
Static Portraits
    Capture these when a Game is Loaded
    Update them when Equipment Changes
    
Wants
    Removed Wants for Inferior Lodging
    
Ranged Combat
    Improved Line of Sight
    Made Battlements Viable
    
Room Detection
    Fixed several Room Detection Failures
    
Alignments
    Introduced Compatibility to guide Recruiting
    Improved Good viability
    
Conversations
    Introduced Compatibility to guide Recruiting
    Prevented useless Topics from being Raised
    Added Filtering to Advanced Topics
    Increased Automation - Nobles talk about your Ruler more
    
Them or Me
    Better surfaced why someone doesn't like someone else
    Added Filtering to Advanced Topics
    Showed Changes in their Relationship
    Introduced Bouquets
    
Pathing
    Prevent Jumping into holes
    Prevent unnecessary use of Grappling Hooks
    
Gameplay Options
    Added Frequency Options
    Added Difficulty Options
    Added Hidden Alignment Option
    Added Hidden Opinions Option[/code]
That's a lot of fixes! We consider most of these items to be a work in progress, and have additional work planned on them as we continue through Early Access.

[i]Priorities as of 8/9.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/6d6580537097dd7f3d2f1c39728ad779a8b2f615.png[/img]

[h2]Content Updates[/h2]
[i]We've released 13 Content Updates so far![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/d87abe364fc7a710c9be3cfde11bde7e2590dbbf.png[/img]

There have been 6 Content Updates since the last Roadmap Update!
[code]Content Update #8:  Stone Stairs
Content Update #9:  Bandit Props
Content Update #10: Cornucopia
Content Update #11: Craftable Crowns
Content Update #12: Background Music
Content Update #13: Wedding Decorations and Growable Grass[/code]
We'll continue to work on these and release them as they're ready, We've started work on some of the more difficult ones internally, so stay tuned for some crunchy Content Updates!

[h2]Feature Updates[/h2]
Finally, we have the Feature Updates. As a reminder, 8 of these will arrive during Early Access. 3 have landed so far.

[i]Feature Update 1: The Hospitality Update![/i]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769420/view/3123811723804780095][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/5c14962dccd0295fadadba2ca1a2b98fed8d6071.png[/img][/url]

[i]Feature Update 2: The Bandit Update![/i]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769420/view/3213888789285191251][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/b0de5b9d8656eac429bc9a2d492623b9970c9d90.png[/img][/url]

[i]Feature Update 3: Love and Elves![/i]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769420/view/3327611022137714953][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ad853297a7957c0f788c04f06a1b4f451f2c4794.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Feature Update #4[/h2]
Feature Update #4 is the beefiest Feature Update we've worked on. We aren't ready to announce it yet, but rest assured that it'll be worth the wait!

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Development wise, we're around 1/3 of the way through what we wanted to accomplish with Early Access. We're tracking a little behind our original schedule, but the support we've received ensures we have the time we need to make the game shine.

[h1]What's new in Main?[/h1]
We did a quick bug pass after the last crier, here are the highlights:

[code]Character visuals (especially Human Females) were tuned and improved!
Rooms and Buildings will no longer extend down through the Terrain!
Improved underground camera behavior!
Silver and Gold are now more plentiful!
Trading now retains selected items when you cycle Trading Partners![/code]
[h1]Community Content[/h1]
[i]Finnley made this awesome Mountain Fortress![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/88b6ca1545ff40f708dc6e40051a0d82bbfd9399.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c320031783e23e955449a853b2317d72748c204d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cb57be5136e39627be72773eabc599548c0a2203.png[/img]

[i]cypr` put Growable Grass to use.[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a7d46ccd7d3c53f41a9529c0934ee14a9b6732f9.png[/img]

[i]dpahfl put the finishing touches on a Cliffside Kingdom![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4dae2caa66c6eeca9c1e1ba569f0fb09d9a37db9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mods[/h1]
[i]MrPurple stood up the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822063795]Noble Fates Twitch Integration[/url] allowing customizable interactions with viewers![/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822063795][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/755af29c3ccd3c82081cb44f5fff6140f624a52f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to participate in Development!
[url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a54c50c85ab2d954f641161dab4a43e3e8c37ad2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
If you like the game, please consider leaving a Review for the game if you haven't already. These help players that may be on the fence to decide whether or not to support us.


Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!
The Noble Fates Team

notes.title: Kingdom-Crier #14: Winners, Wedding Decor, and Growable Grass!
notes.content:
Welcome to Kingdom-Crier #14!

[h1]Mod Contest #2[/h1]
We're excited to announce the winners of the Noble Fates Mod Contest #2.

Without further ado....

[h2]1st Place[/h2]
[i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830425817]KArtistry[/url] by Karma Drak[/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830425817][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e83d5c1fe68b6ab3a4dfccc02acce15e804bb18f.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Karma is unstoppable. Just when they thought they might have ran out of ideas, they put this mod together with the largest breadth of content to date!

Insane.[/i]

[h2]2nd Place[/h2]
[i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819973993]Initial Nobles[/url] by MrPurple6411[/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819973993][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/aa23e0a41de31cf6a84fee68f43bbc683e9fd076.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]MrPurple stood up a multitude of deep, code based mods that will form the basis of a bright future for Modding Nobles Fates.

The one that stands out to us, however, is Initial Nobles. It started out as a way to bypass portions of the intro, but it's growing into a starting scenario editor!

It's very much a work in progress, but tackling the biggest Community ask is more than enough to earn this one a spot on the list and our gratitude![/i]

[h2]3rd Place[/h2]
[i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836737520]Stone Church Windows[/url] by dpahfl[/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836737520][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/57b9e32102eca5f0d2aed67929732d7954a09140.png[/img][/url]
[i]What this mod lacks in breadth, it more than makes up for in charm.

Dpahfl is one of the most active Noble Fates players and much like Karma, their dip into the world of modding appears to have come out of a desire to better express themselves in-game.[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836737520][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ae5562b92bd4ddfc6c77e6eb007034a48ae92dc7.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Not only did dpahfl release these charming Windows, but they put them to use in a series of Screenshots that really capture the essence of the Love & Elves Update and nearly placed in the Screenshot contest themselves![/i]

Congrats everyone!

[b]Click the Images for more details and don't forget to Subscribe![/b]

[h1]Screenshot Contest #2[/h1]
Great entries, here are the winners:

[h2]1st Place[/h2]
[i]Sphere City by TheSaucyFleet[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/545ab0bfbbd64355cb5fac9817160245c4ad89e0.jpg[/img]
[i]TheSaucyFleet did it again! This time with an epic feat of architecture and ingenuity that puts the vertical levels to use![/i]

[i]Bonus behind the scenes shots...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/04888372ea21a811d65b010d28f1237a7c1bb95f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cfd04c5e5015ea4896822442bad2798bb573701a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/37edfe35f5e1f89b7d19dc2cd63669cbae0c1210.jpg[/img]
[i]So many resources![/i]

[h2]2nd Place[/h2]
[i]Village by cypr`[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/bcc3e3136f5698ba8fc208a7f559f17c947350eb.png[/img]
[i]A prominent player, cypr` is often pushing the bounds of what can be done with Noble Fates.

They've built a number of the largest Kingdoms we've seen, producing inspiring shots that capture our attention with the fine detailing.[/i]

[h2]3rd Place[/h2][i]Winter by Finnley[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/905372a603ddd92bd4a7062c3598eabf0dd678d5.png[/img]
[i]Winter is too cool to let this one go by. Fantastic Kingdom and shot by Finnley![/i]

Congrats to the winners, and thanks to everyone who participated!

[h1]Weekly Screenshot Theme[/h1]
With this contest, we introduced the concept a Weekly Screenshot Theme over on the [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Noble Fates Discord[/url] to inspire people to capture something new. Though the contest is over, the themes will continue!

[h1]Content Update #13[/h1]
[i]Last week saw the release of Content Update #13, which included...[/i]

[h2]Wedding Decorations![/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/5568b48f5928ce95cd5ba30128982ce86de4d7f9.png[/img]
[i]Decorate your Wedding Chapel in style with a variety of new indoor/outdoor decorations or put them to use to decorate that new starter home for your lovebirds![/i]

[h2]Growable Grass![/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ce432cb9a261c0ef67307c78ccde070ab4c689e8.png[/img]
[i]Leverage Grass Seeds to plant your own Grass, place it in a pasture to keep your animal friends fed![/i]

[h2]Full Patch Notes:[/h2]
Content Update #13: Wedding Decorations and Growable Grass!
[code]Wedding Decorations (thanks Satoru and Davision!)

There have been a few key changes since the last Crier that were focused on Character visuals - here are the highlights:

[h1]Feature Update #4 Progress[/h1]
Feature Update #4 is well underway, though members of the team have been cycling through vacations to recharge our batteries and catch up on some much needed rest and relaxation.

We're very excited about what's coming next and we think it's going to change up how everyone plays a fair bit! Stay tuned for more details!

notes.title: Kingdom-Crier #13: QOL Improvements and Ongoing Contests
notes.content:
Hey Kontras! Welcome to Kingdom-Crier #13!

[h1]QOL Improvements[/h1]
We've been focusing on quality of life improvements over the last two weeks. We were able to complete and release passes on three major systems during this period - outlined below.

[h2]Buildings/Rooms/Beds[/h2]
This update better surfaced the relationship between Beds, Rooms, and Buildings and softened some of the requirements to better reward your creativity.

[code]Noble Fates 0.26.0.24
Props
    Show the Room a Prop is inside of
        Clicking that will select the Room (even if hidden)
    Better indicate why a Prop cannot be Owned

Rooms
    Show the Room's Category
    Fix Multiple Room Detection Bugs
    Show the Building a Room is inside of
        Clicking it will select the Building (even if hidden)
    Better indicate why a Room cannot be Owned
    Room Types no longer depend on Props being included
    Remove Stock Room Type

Buildings
    Show the Building's Category
    Better indicate why a Building cannot be Owned
    Building Types no longer depend on Rooms being included
    Replace Bunk Hall with Common Building Type
    Add Bedrooms Building Type
    Remove Stock Building Type

Workbenches
    Ownable rooms can now include Workbenches
    Workbenches become decorative if a room is owned by a Mortal
    Add Prestige values to Workbenches that were missing them

Modding
    Add alias keyword
        References to the alias will be replaced with the id on load[/code]
[h2]Movement and Ranged Combat[/h2]
This update was centered on resolving a number of annoying Mortal behaviors related to Jumping down, Climbing, and using Ranged Weapons.

Check out the improved ability to defend your Kingdom from the walls!

[code]Noble Fates 0.26.0.28
Mortal Movement
    Only Jump Down, Deploy Ropes, or Climb Ropes When:
        Leaving as a Visitor
        Engaging as an Enemy
        Ordered to Move to a Specific Position
        Ordered to Move to Engage an Enemy
        Ordered to Pursue Enemies
    Should Prevent a number of Stuck in the Basement Scenarios
        
Ranged Combat
    Fix Line of Sight (was seeing through things before)
    Improve Hit Tests (prevented a number of through the wall cases)
    "Lean out" to Fire down from Ledges/Parapets
        Most useful when combined with Hold Tactic on Wall's Edge
    
Grapple Hooks
    Fix bug that prevented these from landing
    
Catapult
    Fix bugs with non-penetrating boulders
    
Breacher
    Now properly pursues with no LOS

Tactics
    Add Hold Tactic
        O Hotkey
        When Holding, Mortals will not Evade or Move to Reach Targets
    Add Tooltips to Tactics Buttons
    
Combat
    Fix bug that prevented Attack Order from finishing
    Fix bug where a Mortal would get stuck trying to return to Defensive Position
    
Incoming Attack Notification
    Now properly pops up even if people are Enlisted
    
UI
    Increase Brightness of Highlighted UI Elements[/code]
[h2]Compatibility and Conversations[/h2]
This update focused on better surfacing Compatibility between Mortals and your Ruler and Streamlining Conversations. 

It's much easier to drill in and tell a Mortal things that will improve their relationship with another Mortal.

[code]Noble Fates 0.26.1.33
Save Compatibility
    0.26.0 Saves can be loaded in 0.26.1 Builds.
    0.26.1 Saves cannot be loaded in 0.26.0 Builds.

Compatibility
    Gives an overview of the Compatibility between a given Mortal and your Ruler
    The higher the Compatibility, the easier it will be to maintain their Esteem
    Show Compatibility (and Warn if Low) when making a decision about a Mortal
    Add Compatibility Tab to the Character Sheet
    Add Compatibility to the Intro (under Kingdom)
    Add Compatibility to Conversations
    
Conversations
    Separate Gossip and Relationship Building
        What's On Your Mind? - Build relationship
        What have you Heard? - Learn about the World
    
    Add Subject Filters to help find Subjects Faster
        Rulers...
        Kingdoms...
        Jobs...
        Gear...
        Food...
        Items...
        Your Mortals...
        Mortals...
        
    Share Information About...
        Add Up and Down Filters
            These filter down to only the info that will produce an effect
            Sorts information by amount
            
        Other Mortals
            Show Opinion of the Subject Mortal instead of Esteem
            
    Esteem/Opinion Changes
        Show Opinion changes when talking about another Mortal
        Don't wait to progress the Conversation on these
        Improve accuracy of calculation

Socialization
    Mortals will now talk about their Ruler more often when speaking to one-another
    
Esteem Balance
    Opinion/Alignment/Racial Esteem Deltas last longer
    Lower scale of Opinion Esteem Deltas
    Raise scale of Alignment Esteem Deltas
    Raise scale of Racial Esteem Deltas
    Lower scale of War Esteem Deltas
    Lower scale of Raid Esteem Deltas
    Reduce Importance of Opinion of Rulers
    Remove redundant post-Raid Esteem boost
    
Attraction
    Increase the chance that a Mortal will be attracted to multiple Genders
    Show Suitors for Visitors
    
Good Mortals
    Take Opinion of Interactor into greater account with Moral Interactions
    
Options
    Added Option to Show Unlearned Opinions
    Added Option to Show Unlearned Alignments
    
Information
    Stop tracking history of what people have Eaten
    Learn information that anyone in your Kingdom learns
    Text Iteration
    Reduce Empathy towards Raids
    Reduce Empathy towards Declarations of War

Swaying Opinion
    Swaying opinion now properly costs Esteem[/code]
[h1]Ongoing Contests[/h1]
[h2]Screenshot Contest #2[/h2]
Reminder - we're running Screenshot Contest #2. We've received some good entries, but there's plenty of time to take the crown!

Take a sweet new screenshot of the game and post it to #kingdom-shots on our Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to enter. First Place will receive $75 USD, Second: $35 USD, and Third: $15 USD. The contest runs through 7/24 at 11:59 PST. 

Full terms can be found on our [url=https://noblefates.userecho.com/en/knowledge-bases/2/articles/1257-active-contests]User Echo[/url].

[h2]Mod Contest #2[/h2]
In addition, we're running Mod Contest #2. There have been a few excellent entries, but there's still plenty of time to compete!

Release a Mod on the Steam Workshop and share it in #mod-announcements on our Official  [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to enter. First Place will receive $300 USD, Second: $150 USD, and Third: $75 USD. The contest runs through 7/24 at 11:59 PST. 

Existing mods will be considered if they have received significant updates after the previous contest.

Full terms can be found on our [url=https://noblefates.userecho.com/en/knowledge-bases/2/articles/1257-active-contests]User Echo[/url].

[h1]Community Content[/h1]
[i]cypr` built an impressive Village![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a0e68288e98f3b09da76055d8e75c9c4ada60ff9.png[/img]

[i]Scott (senses) captured a great action shot during an Epic Battle![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/4ab1e8eee62a01970327b42d60997e467d2e22a8.png[/img]

[i]Somebody built a great Chateau for their ruler![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7eeb0284f3809e16b50b7a8884030916e9c4254e.png[/img]

[h1]Mods[/h1]
[i]Karma Drak has dropped the amazing [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2830425817]KArtistry[/url] mod![/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2830425817][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/e83d5c1fe68b6ab3a4dfccc02acce15e804bb18f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS]Discord[/url] to participate in Development and Contests!
[url=https://discord.gg/HeAaQcS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/a54c50c85ab2d954f641161dab4a43e3e8c37ad2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
If you like the game and the updates, please consider leaving a Review for the game if you haven't already. These help players that may be on the fence to decide whether or not to support us.


Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!
The Noble Fates Team

Hail Kontras! Welcome to Kingdom-Crier #12!

[h1]Content Update #12 - Background Music[/h1]
We've partnered with our composer Thomas Himblot on a new trio of Background Music tracks and Satoru took care of hooking them up! We've upped the base length a track will play for and lowered the amount of downtime between tracks.

The three new tracks are:
[list]
[*] Pizzicato Melody
[*] Calm Voice
[*] Guitar Space
[/list]
Enjoy!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
Content Update #12
[code]Background Music
    New Tracks!

        Calm Voice
        Guitar Space

    Decrease time between tracks
    
Hang Fix

We're spending a little time over the next few weeks prioritizing quality of life improvements.

The first of these was released yesterday - improving the relationship between Beds, Rooms, and Buildings and better allowing navigation between them even when a Room or Building's Visibility Category is hidden.

We're working on a few other key systems, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Kingdom-Crier #11: Love and Elves has Released!
notes.content:
Hey hey, the time has finally come!

Feature Update #3 has been released!

[h1]Love and Elves![/h1]
[h3]Noble Fates Feature Update #3[/h3]

Elves have come to Noberia from far away lands, bringing the custom of Marriage with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/00af14a347c2d6095afd870a273742c5452c097f.png[/img]

Can you find the perfect partners for your people?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/036f4d3bd78d58b0082b0e4f433a64b7c0fad5e5.png[/img]

[h2]Elves![/h2]
A patient Race - Elves live twice as long as Humans and Orcs, but take their time maturing - progressing at half the rate of the other Races.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/edda91398175d16aa1ad0d6efde24adceaf8d221.png[/img]

Elves don't mind Humans, but can be at odds with the Orcs!

Elves have increased potential in Hunting and Crafting, though their smaller frame limits their potential in Melee.

[h2]Updated Characters![/h2]
To ensure the adoption of Marriage across the lands, the Gods have blessed the other Mortal Races with new faces, haircuts, and finally... Ears!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/752f374878909616ce91bc725d8125d239017278.png[/img]

Enjoy new Human and Orc faces with many more variation and much more detail than before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/481af4c1b7cf28fc1da66d447563270d4200a2bd.png[/img]

[h2]Attraction![/h2]
Now that the Mortals are more beautiful, they've discovered that they're now Attracted to one another!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/cbb404dacdd9f395cdb0a970c671cfe7e5f03179.png[/img]

Browse the new Attraction tab on the Character Sheet to see what each Mortal is into.

Mortals have a broad range of preferences - taking Gender, Age, Race, and even wealth into account when sizing up a potential partner.

[h2]Gifts![/h2]
The Mortals have discovered that they can grow and harvest Flowers, making Bouquets for gifts to maximize their chances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/7173347bc3de08ce2ec583fe8365af59affc7240.png[/img]

Daily gifts can help that friendship blossom into true Love!

Use the additional details on the expanded Relationship tab to see just why two Mortals love one-another or why they aren't getting along.

[h2]Marriage![/h2]
Build and decorate the new Wedding Arch to arrange a Wedding between two of your Mortals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/1d24ba14f6c3124b42f4845832ba66dcbd3185fb.png[/img]

Marry an Enamored pair of Mortals to transform their shared Love into Loyalty or arrange a one-sided Marriage to keep an important Noble happy!

Interactions with a Mortal's partner have increased effects on that Mortal - treat your Mortal's partners well to keep them happy.

Leverage Double Beds and shared Lodgings to simplify housing for your growing Kingdom!
 
Marriages last until one of the partners dies, so make sure you make the right call when choosing a Mortal's partner!

[h2]Expanded Intro Details and Options![/h2]
This was the perfect time to increase the information shared during the Intro and we've coupled that with the introduction of per-Mortal Reroll support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/ade40d75eed31556b5c00e7e0cb0ce4fabb0c5f8.png[/img]

We plan to do more with the Intro as we move further into EA, but this should help those of you looking for that perfect group from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/172199ccfb9aee15c6f681108c4939f63829db7d.png[/img]

[h2]Other Surprises[/h2]
Beyond Elves, we've also added Innate abilities to the other Races - Orcs have higher potential in Melee and Mining, but lower in Hunting; Humans have increased Building and Farming but aren't as capable in Foraging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/5a755be808d062391244cf9b1fe6b10a12e8af3d.png[/img]

In addition, we introduced Skirts and Blouses - a slightly nicer variant of Tunics and Leggings that can roll brighter colors - perfect for a Wedding!

The Experimental Beta included Top Hats and Veils - but we've expanded both to include a wider array of colors.

Finally - we've introduced new Breach Music - fitting music for a fitting end for a Kingdom.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
Leverage the new Caps Visibility toggle to let those luscious locks loose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584603/c51cb79212445a753f68d3f249123866252089be.png[/img]

We retuned Depth of Field to better accommodate close-ups of your new faces.

We rebalanced Kingdom Size preference - more Mortals than ever will prefer Medium or Large Kingdoms.

Finally, we optimized startup time! Even with the added burden of the new Character Art, the game should load faster and use less memory than ever before!

[h3]Saves[/h3]
These changes necessitated changes to the save game format, so this update retires 0.25 saves.

We've spun up a retired_0_25 set of Steam Betas so that you can continue your 0.25 saves there or go back and visit them whenever you want.
